title: P1 M25 backend endpoint 测试 (m10-revision + m10-style + m11-worldview)
description: 为 P1 M25 系列 MCP endpoints 补全测试：m10-revision.ts 含 reviseMultiPassEndpoint（调用 RevisionServiceImpl），m10-style.ts 含 styleExtractEndpoint/styleProfileEndpoint/styleApplyEndpoint（含 extractStyle 分析函数），m11-worldview.ts 含 worldviewExtractEndpoint/worldviewGetEndpoint（调用 WorldviewExtractor）。当前零测试覆盖。
action: Create m10-revision-endpoint.test.ts, m10-style-endpoint.test.ts, m11-worldview-endpoint.test.ts under src-ts/tests/mcp/ using makeRequest() helper + vi.mock pattern from memory-endpoints.test.ts

criteria: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m10-revision-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m10-style-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m11-worldview-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
convergence.verification: Run vitest for each new test file in src-ts/ and confirm all pass with 0 failures
convergence.definition_of_done: m10-revision、m10-style、m11-worldview 三个 M25 endpoint 模块均有回归测试，覆盖请求验证、服务调用、错误路径，所有测试通过

files.change: Create test suite: reviseMultiPassEndpoint with empty text → 400, valid text with mocked RevisionServiceImpl.revise → 200 (verify completed/iterations/finalScore/reason mapping), RevisionServiceImpl.revise throws → 500 error response, default target_score=8.0 and max_iterations=5

Create test suite: styleExtractEndpoint with empty text → 400, valid English text → 200 with profile (avgSentenceLength, vocabRichness, dialogueRatio, tensePreference, dominantPOV), valid Chinese text → 200 with CJK word count; styleProfileEndpoint with missing projectId → 400, valid projectId → 200; styleApplyEndpoint with empty text → 400, valid text + style_profile → 200 with context guidance string

Create test suite: worldviewExtractEndpoint with empty chapters → 400, valid chapters with mocked WorldviewExtractor.quickExtract → 200 (settings + count), WorldviewExtractor.quickExtract throws → 500 error; worldviewGetEndpoint with missing projectId → 400, valid projectId → 200 with settings array

implementation: Read m10-revision.ts: reviseMultiPassEndpoint uses lazy RevisionServiceImpl singleton, calls service.revise(text, options, chapterId), maps RevisionCycleResult to response shape (completed, revisedContent, iterations, initialScore, finalScore, finalDecision, learningInsights, comparison, reason), catch → 500

Create m10-revision-endpoint.test.ts: vi.mock('../../services/revision-service.js') with mock revolve function, makeRequest helper, test empty text → 400, test valid text with mocked revise returning APPROVED → verify completed=true and reason='quality_threshold_met', test HUMAN_REVIEW → completed=true reason='human_review_required', test max_iterations_reached → completed=false, test service.revise throws → 500

Read m10-style.ts: styleExtractEndpoint validates text, calls extractStyle() (pure function computing avgSentenceLength, vocabRichness, dialogueRatio, tensePreference, avgParagraphLength, sentenceLengthDistribution, dominantPOV, sampleHash); styleProfileEndpoint reads projectId from params; styleApplyEndpoint validates text + builds guidance string from style_profile

Create m10-style-endpoint.test.ts: makeRequest helper, test styleExtractEndpoint empty text → 400, test with English prose → 200 with profile fields (verify avgSentenceLength is number, vocabRichness 0-1, tensePreference in ['past','present','mixed'], dominantPOV in ['first','third','mixed']), test with Chinese text → verify CJK character counting works; test styleProfileEndpoint missing projectId → 400; test styleApplyEndpoint empty text → 400, valid → 200 with context string containing style parameters
Read m11-worldview.ts: worldviewExtractEndpoint validates chapters array, calls extractor.quickExtract(chapters), returns settings+count; worldviewGetEndpoint validates projectId from params

Create m11-worldview-endpoint.test.ts: vi.mock('../../narrative/worldview-extractor.js'), makeRequest helper, test empty chapters → 400, test valid chapters → 200, test WorldviewExtractor throws → 500; test worldviewGetEndpoint missing projectId → 400, valid → 200

commands: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m10-revision-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m10-style-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/mcp/m11-worldview-endpoint.test.ts --reporter=verbose

reference.pattern: MCP endpoint test pattern with service mocking (makeRequest + vi.mock for service dependencies)

rationale.chosen_approach: Group all 3 M25 endpoint modules into one task because they share the same test pattern (makeRequest + service mock) and represent a coherent M25 subsystem scope
decision_factors: All 3 modules are M25 MCP endpoints with zero test coverage
m10-revision needs RevisionServiceImpl mock, m11-worldview needs WorldviewExtractor mock
m10-style is pure computation (no service mock needed) — simpler
Grouping reduces agent spawn overhead (one task vs three)
rationale.tradeoffs: Single task covers 3 modules in 3 test files — each file is independent so parallel test execution is possible, but one agent writes all 3

risks: m10-revision uses lazy singleton (let revisionService: IRevisionService | null = null) — vi.mock + vi.resetModules needed to reset between tests
WorldviewExtractor is module-level const (const extractor = new WorldviewExtractor()) — need vi.mock to replace
m10-style extractStyle is a module-level pure function — may need to test it directly for branch coverage or test via endpoint only
